COMM-ACC-TYPE: A variable used to store the account type of a customer in the CICS Bank Sample Application (CBSA).

ISA, MORTGAGE, SAVING, CURRENT, LOAN - The specific account types 'ISA', 'MORTGAGE', 'SAVING', 'CURRENT', and 'LOAN' are the possible values for COMM-ACC-TYPE. (see src/base/cobol_src/CREACC.cbl:1216: EVALUATE TRUE WHEN COMM-ACC-TYPE IN DFHCOMMAREA(1:3) = 'ISA')
    
Used in the following paths:

src/base/cobol_src/UPDACC.cbl
src/base/cobol_src/BNK1DAC.cbl
src/base/cobol_src/BNK1UAC.cbl
src/base/cobol_src/CREACC.cbl
src/base/cobol_src/INQACCCU.cbl
src/base/cobol_src/DELCUS.cbl

ABND-PROGRAM: A variable that holds the name of the program that caused an abend (abnormal end) in a CICS transaction.


    
Used in the following paths:

src/base/cobol_copy/ABNDINFO.cpy
src/base/cobol_src/CRDTAGY4.cbl

COMM-SCODE: COMM-SCODE is a variable used to store the sort code of a customer or account. It is a 6-character field used in various parts of the application, such as updating account information, validating data, and linking to other functions.


    
Used in the following paths:

src/base/cobol_src/UPDACC.cbl
src/base/cobol_src/BNK1CCA.cbl
src/base/cobol_src/BNK1DAC.cbl
src/base/cobol_src/UPDCUST.cbl
src/base/cobol_src/INQACCCU.cbl
src/base/cobol_src/DELCUS.cbl
src/base/cobol_src/BNK1UAC.cbl
src/base/cobol_src/BNK1DCS.cbl

COMM-UPD-FAIL-CD: A variable used to indicate the reason for a failure in updating customer information in the CICS Bank Sample Application (CBSA).

'1' - The customer number was not found. (see src/base/cobol_src/UPDCUST.cbl, line 237: MOVE '1' TO COMM-UPD-FAIL-CD)
'2' - An error occurred other than the customer number not being found. (see src/base/cobol_src/UPDCUST.cbl, line 239: MOVE '2' TO COMM-UPD-FAIL-CD)
'3' - A CICS response other than normal occurred. (see src/base/cobol_src/UPDCUST.cbl, line 308: MOVE '3' TO COMM-UPD-FAIL-CD)
'4' - The customer name or address is empty or blank. (see src/base/cobol_src/UPDCUST.cbl, line 266: MOVE '4' TO COMM-UPD-FAIL-CD)
    
Used in the following paths:

src/base/cobol_src/BNK1DCS.cbl
src/base/cobol_copy/UPDCUST.cpy
src/base/cobol_src/UPDCUST.cbl
